pages.text: This mod gives maids a real physics body. A maid in ragdoll state is no longer a normal entity: she falls apart into loose parts that tumble, roll, and can be pushed around by players, mobs and moving contraptions.$(br2)Break any of her parts and the whole ragdoll is gone - the maid is back as a regular entity.

Not every model can be ragdolled. Turn on advanced tooltips with F3 + H and open a maid's model screen: supported models are marked with a "Supports ragdoll" line, and their ragdoll ID is shown as well.
Everything added by this mod can be switched off one by one in the mod's config screen, so this category doubles as a checklist of what is currently enabled.
